name: smwmusic-sonic-3d-blast-genesis-le-epic-bonus-music-special-stage-remix
title: Sonic 3D Blast (Genesis) - Le Epic Bonus Music ~ Special Stage (Remix)
description:
Did an arrangement of the Special Stage theme from Sonic 3D Blast / Flickies Island. Haven't done a single track from this banger OST, and after being reminded of a SiIvagunner rip, I thought it'd be fun to do this.

Important:
♠ "Bonus End" & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. A Minor (Remix Pitch, turned on default)
2. G# Minor (Original Pitch)
